🎥🎬: Super Troopers 3 (2026)

The legendary Vermont State Troopers are back, and their latest adventure is filled with even more chaos, confusion, and completely unpredictable police work. When the team takes on a bizarre investigation involving unusual suspects, outrageous criminals, and a case that quickly spirals out of control, the troopers must rely on their questionable instincts and unmatched teamwork to get the job done.

With the return of the original cast, Super Troopers 3 brings back the franchise’s signature humor, unforgettable pranks, and ridiculous situations that made it a comedy cult classic. Packed with hilarious rivalries, nonstop laughs, and the same outrageous energy fans have been waiting for, the troopers prove once again that nobody handles chaos quite like they do.

source_details.synopsis: Super Troopers 3 (billed as Super Troopers 3: Farva’s Wedding, onscreen only) is a 2026 American comedy film directed by Jay Chandrasekhar. A sequel to the 2018 film Super Troopers 2, the film was written by and stars the Broken Lizard comedy team, made up of Chandrasekhar, Kevin Heffernan, Steve Lemme, Paul Soter and Erik Stolhanske. Super Troopers 3 was released in the United States by Searchlight Pictures on August 7, 2026, it received mixed reviews from critics.
